reason: `Expression.ConstItem` is a core expression/planner contract, and this PR changes that contract across many expression implementations plus planner call sites. Even though the title sounds like an API cleanup, constness classification directly affects constant folding, constant propagation, partition pruning, and planner decisions; a new boolean mode parameter raises a real risk of semantic divergence between callers or incorrect propagation in edge cases. The touch set is broad enough, and the affected paths are central enough, to justify a focused deep review for high-severity optimizer/expression correctness regressions.
